# Josh Popkin

> Josh Popkin is a marketing engineer based in New York City. He rebuilds websites for independent
> businesses so that people and AI assistants can find, understand and recommend them, and measures
> the result in how often those businesses appear in AI answers rather than only in search rankings.

## Verified facts

- Full name: Joshua Paul Popkin, known as Josh Popkin
- Role: Marketing engineer
- Location: New York City, USA
- Education: MBA, Cornell Tech (2025); BSBA, Bucknell University (2018)
- Practice: Answer engine optimization (AEO), search optimization, website architecture, marketing automation
- Measurement tools used: Profound, Peec AI, Google Search Console, IndexNow
- Book: *Play Offense* (Amazon)
- Music: releases as Josh Popkin on Spotify and Apple Music; latest single "Untouchable"
- Earlier career: performed stand-up comedy 2013–2020; founded Bucknell University's first stand-up
  comedy club; appeared on the Kill Tony podcast
- Terms of work: website rebuilds for small businesses are free; payment is an honest testimonial
- Contact: jpp234@cornell.edu
